name: Bravi
long_description:
Bravi helps manufacturers of windows, doors, and other home improvement products turn fragmented technical and commercial data into tools their teams can use instantly. 

Our AI platform helps sales, customer service, and field teams answer technical questions, configure complex products, generate quotes, and retrieve order information by connecting to existing documentation, catalogs, ERP, CRM, and pricing systems.

Bravi is already live with leading installers and manufacturers across Europe and the US, turning missed demand into revenue.
one_liner: AI operating system for home improvement manufacturers

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We (Anas and Pierre-Habté) met at UC Berkeley in 2017 and immediately started working together on tech projects. After co-founding Snipfeed, scaling it to 20+ people, and selling the company in 2024, we knew we wanted to build again together.

The idea for Bravi came from a very personal pain point: my family runs a shutter installation business in France, and I saw firsthand how many calls and leads were missed every day. On top of that, I launched a side business, Volet Dumont, selling shutters online, and experienced the same chaos with quoting and customer communication.

We realized installers were losing 30–40% of potential revenue just from slow follow-ups, missed calls, and disorganized workflows. With our background in automation and product scaling, we decided to tackle it head-on.

That’s how Bravi was born: combining our founder-market fit, validated by hundreds of conversations with installers, with the conviction that AI assistants could transform how home service companies capture and convert leads.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder & CEO of Bravi (YC F25), the AI communication platform for home service companies. 
Alongside Bravi, he also runs Volet Dumont, an online rolling shutter business that serves as a live testing ground for Bravi’s technology and customer workflows.
He previously co-founded Snipfeed in 2017, where he scaled the company to 20+ employees before its acquisition in 2024. 
Anas holds a Master Degree from UC Berkeley and a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from EPFL.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CPTO of Bravi. Previously co-founded and exited Snipfeed ($7M raised, 20+ employees). South American Math Olympiad #1. Trained as a space/aerospace engineer before moving into ML and AI product.

launches.title: Bravi - AI voice and chat assistants for home service companies
launches.tagline: The AI assistant that helps home service companies capture every lead
launches.body:
👋 We’re [Pierre-Habté](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pierre-habte-nouvellon/) & [Anas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anas-bouassami/) from [Bravi (F25)](https://bravi.app/) and we are bulding AI voice and chat assistants for home service companies.

youtube.com/watch?v=Zl3jtIK_yco&feature=youtu.be

**TL;DR:** Bravi builds **AI voice & chat assistants** for home service installers (shutters, solar, HVAC, carpentry) and manufacturers. We help them capture every lead, follow up instantly, and close more jobs.

### **Problem**

**Missed revenue**

Most installers and manufacturers selling directly to consumers lose **30–40% of potential revenue** because they miss calls, don’t answer emails, and fail to respond to chats in time. Every unanswered lead is lost business.

**Broken communication workflows**

Sales, admin, and field teams rely on **manual callbacks, scattered inboxes, and slow CRMs**, which makes it impossible to respond instantly or follow up consistently. That lag costs them real money.

**Tools not made for them**

Generic chatbots and call centers don’t understand **home service workflows** — quotes, site visits, or product specs — leaving customers frustrated and companies unable to scale efficiently.

### **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94602&key=user_uploads/231836/5c45980d-e8ee-4351-bb93-f7f115717a92)

Bravi fixes this with AI agents that:

* **Answer calls & chats** 24/7
* **Pre-qualify leads** (project type, urgency, location)
* **Book** **callbacks** for the team
* **Create tasks & reminders** for team members to ensure follow-through
* **Generate** and **Send** **quotes** automatically

### **Our Story**

This isn’t theory. We (Anas & Pierre) met at UC Berkeley in 2017. After co-founding and scaling our first startup to 20+ employees (acquired in 2024), we wanted to build again, this time in a space we knew personally.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94602&key=user_uploads/231836/4bd905c2-fa8c-4c65-91dc-f0891a474e13)

Anas grew up in a **family shutter installation business** and later launched an **online shutter e-commerce store** (Volet Dumont). Both showed us the same pain: installers drowning in leads, but losing 30–40% of potential revenue.

That’s how **Bravi** was born.

### **🙏 Our Ask**

If you answer “yes” to any of these, we’d love your help:

* Do you know **installers, manufacturers, or contractors** in home services (shutters, solar, HVAC, carpentry…) who struggle with missed calls or slow follow-ups?

  👉 Invite them to test **Bravi** for free at [www.bravi.app](http://www.bravi.app)
* Can you introduce us to **B2B2C manufacturers** selling directly to consumers who could benefit from AI assistants handling their inbound calls, chats, and emails 24/7?
* Are you working with or know **digital agencies** or **industry partners** that build websites for installers and could integrate Bravi’s AI assistants into their clients’ sites?

💬 We’d love to connect — every intro or feedback helps us make sure **no home service business ever loses a lead again**

📩 Reach us anytime at [**anas@bravi.app**](mailto:anas@bravi.app)
